project_type: React 19 SPA (Vite 8) - SaaS agency landing page
build_system: Vite 8 with tsc type checking. Runtime is bun (no npm/node directly available). node_modules already installed.
test_framework: No test framework configured - visual project, validation is via build success
test_command: bun run build (no test suite - this is a landing page)
verification_instructions: Run 'bun run build' to verify TypeScript compiles and Vite produces dist output without errors
environment_constraints: No npm/node binary directly - use 'bun' instead. Bun 1.2.14 available. Node.js version warning from Vite but build succeeds. OPEN_INTERNET network mode - can install any packages.
contribution_requirements: Working on feature/saas-landing-page branch. No CONTRIBUTING.md. Keep TypeScript strict.
key_patterns: Components in src/components/. Animation variants in src/utils/animations.ts. Framer Motion used for all animations with useReducedMotion support. Tailwind CSS for styling with custom theme colors (background #0a0a0f, surface #12121a, accent-purple #a855f7, accent-cyan #06b6d4). BorderGlow component for interactive card glow effects. Glassmorphism patterns. Font: Boska (display) + Inter (body).
directory_structure: Root: index.html, package.json, tailwind.config.js, vite.config.ts, tsconfig*.json. src/: main.tsx, App.tsx, index.css. src/components/: all page sections. src/utils/: animation variants.
